description: This PHP source file defines the class SugarWebServiceUtilv4, extending functionalities for interacting with SugarCRM's web services, including methods for fetching module view definitions, data lists, module details, handling entries, session validation, and retrieving subpanel definitions.

classes.name: SugarWebServiceUtilv4
classes.description: A utility class extending SugarWebServiceUtilv3_1 to provide web service functionalities for SuiteCRM, including view definitions, data retrieval, session checks, and subpanel definitions.

methods.name: get_module_view_defs
methods.description: Retrieves module view definitions based on module name, view type, and view category, loading metadata files and applying ACLs.

methods.name: get_data_list
methods.description: Fetches a list of data from a given seed object with various filtering, ordering, and pagination options.

methods.name: getModulesFromList
methods.description: Converts a list of module identifiers into web service result format, including labels and ACL info.

methods.name: is_favorites_enabled
methods.description: Indicates whether the given module has favorites feature enabled (stub implementation returning false).

methods.name: filter_fields_for_query
methods.description: Processes filter fields for querying SugarBean objects, filtering based on field definitions.

methods.name: get_field_list
methods.description: Generates a list of field definitions and link fields for a given bean, with translation and special handling.

methods.name: new_handle_set_entries
methods.description: Handles creation or updating of records in bulk, including duplicate detection, ACL checks, and handling related records like contacts and meetings.

methods.name: checkSessionAndModuleAccess
methods.description: Validates session and module access, including OAuth authentication if applicable.

methods.name: checkOAuthAccess
methods.description: Performs OAuth token validation and initializes session state for authenticated users.

methods.name: get_subpanel_defs
methods.description: Loads and filters subpanel metadata definitions for a module, respecting ACL permissions.
